item.title: Self-Hosted Network Port Scanners: Masscan vs RustScan vs Naabu
item.description: Network port scanning is a foundational technique in network security, used by administrators to audit firewall rules, discover running services, and identify potential attack surfaces. While cloud-based scanners exist, self-hosted port scanners give you full control over scan parameters, data retention, and scheduling — without sharing your network topology with third parties.
